narrative.details:
Oh, so you've got more courage than sense, then? Fine, I won't argue.

Ferauu and his goons aren't due to pick up their take of the harvest just yet, so I'm going to put you to work for your meals until they arrive.

Head outside and gather today's batch of stormapples for me. Oh, and the bandits lurking around the stormapple trees... They think they are sneaky. They aren't. Kill them for me.

Let's see what you've got in a fight.
narrative.objectives: Gather 10 Ripe Stormapples and slay 5 Hungry Bandits at the Windfield Orchard.
narrative.offerRewardText: I watched you take down those bandits from the window. Not bad.
narrative.requestItemsText: These bandits are more likely to double cross and steal from each other than they are to steal from normal folks. I bet if Ferauu knew some of his people went rogue and came here early to tamper with the harvest, he'd kill them himself.
